title: NegT2IBench: When Negation Changes the Picture. A Polarity Benchmark for Text-to-Image Models
title_zh: NegT2IBench：当否定改变画面时。面向文本到图像模型的一种极性基准测试

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image (T2I) models are judged by benchmarks that measure whether requested content appears, but these benchmarks largely overlook the complementary ability to satisfy negated constraints, for example, generating “a non-red cup.” Measuring negation raises challenges not faced by affirmation-based benchmarks and requires careful prompt and evaluation design. We introduce NegT2IBench , a benchmark of 4,800 prompts covering two attribute types and four relation categories. Prompts are organized by polarity : the number of positive statements that must hold and negated statements that must not, each ranging from 0 to 2. Varying the two independently separates the effect of negation from the effect of prompt complexity. Our detector-based scoring is reproducible, auditable, and pinpoints which requirement failed. On 600 images with three-annotator labels, it agrees with humans as closely as vision-language judges up to 30 × 30\times larger, while using only a fraction of their GPU memory. Across eleven T2I models and 211,200 images, nine score lower on a single negated statement than on a single positive one. Per-statement scoring reveals that the loss is largest for color and near zero for proximity, and that 41.5% of failed statements render exactly what the prompt forbids. Rendering what a prompt asks for and withholding what it forbids are distinct capabilities that an aggregate compositional score cannot distinguish. NegT2IBench measures the latter directly, providing a controlled testbed for diagnosing negation failures and developing methods to overcome them.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像（T2I）模型通常通过基准测试来评估，这些测试衡量所请求的内容是否出现，但这些基准测试在很大程度上忽略了满足否定约束的互补能力，例如生成“一个非红色的杯子”。测量否定能力会提出肯定性基准测试所没有的挑战，并需要精心设计的提示和评估方案。 我们提出了 NegT2IBench，这是一个包含 4,800 个提示的基准测试，涵盖了两种属性类型和四类关系。 提示按极性进行组织：必须成立的肯定陈述数量以及必须不成立的否定陈述数量，每个范围均为 0 到 2。 独立调整这两个参数可以将否定的影响与提示复杂性的影响区分开来。 我们基于检测器的评分方法具有可重复性、可审计性，并能准确指出哪项要求未满足。 在 600 张由三名标注员标注的图像上，该方法的评分与人类标注的一致性，与规模高达 30 × 30\times 的视觉-语言模型相当，而仅使用了其 GPU 内存的一小部分。 在十一个 T2I 模型和 211,200 张图像中，有九个模型在单个否定陈述上的得分低于单个肯定陈述。 按陈述评分显示，颜色相关的损失最大，而邻近性相关的损失接近于零；此外，41.5% 的失败陈述实际上生成了提示所禁止的内容。 生成提示所要求的内容与排除提示所禁止的内容是两种不同的能力，而综合性的组合得分无法区分这两者。 NegT2IBench 直接测量了后一种能力，为诊断否定失败和开发克服这些失败的方法提供了一个受控的测试平台。

paragraphs.en: While text-to-image (T2I) models now render increasingly complex prompts accurately enough for professional [ 53 ] and creative [ 36 ] applications, evaluating whether they respect what a prompt forbids is surprisingly difficult and underexplored. paragraphs.en: Measuring negation raises challenges not faced by affirmation-based benchmarks, making it more nuanced than simply adding negated prompts to existing benchmarks. First, success can be accidental: cups rarely fly, so “a cup that is not flying” can produce a valid image even if not was ignored. Second, if object presence is not verified, a negated attribute can be satisfied by omitting the object rather than the attribute: “a non-wooden bench” may simply omit the bench. Third, negation inherits the difficulty of dense prompts; adding objects, like “a red cup” vs. “a red cup with no spoon” introduces multiple potential failures, so failures from negation must be disentangled from those from prompt complexity. Fourth, the evaluator can also introduce errors: when checking for forbidden elements, vision-language models may report absent content [ 40 ] or hallucinate [ 62 ] , making evaluator errors difficult to distinguish from image-generation errors.
paragraphs.zh: 对否定进行测量会引发肯定性基准测试所没有的挑战，这使得这一过程比在现有基准测试中简单添加否定提示要更为复杂。 首先，成功可能是偶然的：杯子很少会飞，因此“一个不飞的杯子”即使忽略了“不”，也可能生成一张有效的图像。 其次，如果未验证对象是否存在，否定属性可能通过省略该对象而非否定属性来满足：“一个非木制的长凳”可能直接省略长凳本身。 第三，否定继承了密集提示的复杂性；添加对象（例如，“一个红色的杯子”与“一个没有勺子的红色杯子”）会引入多种潜在失败，因此必须将否定导致的失败与提示复杂性导致的失败区分开来。 第四，评估器本身也可能引入错误：在检查禁止元素时，视觉语言模型可能会报告不存在的内容 [ 40 ] 或产生幻觉 [ 62 ]，这使得评估器的错误难以与图像生成错误区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We introduce NegT2IBench , a benchmark for measuring negation in text-to-image generation, designed around these four challenges. To reduce accidental success, an LLM [ 65 ] selects plausible attributes and relations, and fixed templates keep wording consistent across conditions. To prevent success by omission, evaluation requires every named object to appear: i.e., “a non-wooden bench” still requires a bench. To isolate negation from prompt complexity, prompts are organized by polarity , the number of positive statements that must hold and negated statements that must not; prompts with the same statement count contain the same object count and differ only in polarity. Finally, to limit evaluator error, each requirement is checked by a dedicated perception component rather than by an LLM judge, revealing which requirement failed. NegT2IBench covers two attribute categories (color and material) and four relation categories (directional, proximity, comparative, and depth).

paragraphs.en: We evaluate eleven T2I models on the full corpus, four samples per prompt totaling 211,200 images (Section 5 ). Nine of eleven models score lower on a single negated statement than on a single positive one, by up to 43.8 % 43.8\% points. The drop differs by category: color falls from 85.0 % 85.0\% to 31.3 % 31.3\% , while proximity barely moves, 45.8 % 45.8\% vs. 43.2 % 43.2\% . At the highest tested complexity, no model exceeds 8.4 % 8.4\% . More strikingly, 41.5 % 41.5\% of failed statements are negated violations: the image shows the attribute or relation the prompt forbids. Ranking also changes with polarity: FLUX.2-dev leads on the single positive statement and Janus-Pro-7B on the negated one, so a single score hides the effect. Replacing SD 1.5’s text encoder with negation-aware NegationCLIP [ 47 ] improves accuracy only from 14.5 % 14.5\% to 14.9 % 14.9\% . Negation is therefore a failure mode of its own, and one that an aggregate score cannot reveal.

paragraphs.en: Contributions. (1) NegT2IBench , a negation benchmark for T2I models with 4,800 4{,}800 prompts over 79 79 object classes, six categories, and eight polarity settings, scored using only detection and geometry. Whereas prior negation evaluation for generation focuses on negated objects, NegT2IBench also negates attributes and relations while requiring the corresponding objects to remain present, and compares positive and negated prompts at matched prompt complexity. (2) An evaluator validation study against human annotation on 600 600 images, comparing NegT2IBench with 14 alternative scoring methods separately for positive and negated statements. (3) A fine-grained analysis of negation failures across eleven T2I configurations, six categories, and eight polarity settings, including matched-load polarity comparisons and a statement-level failure taxonomy that reveals where and how models fail.
paragraphs.zh: 贡献。 (1) NegT2IBench，一个用于 T2I 模型的否定基准测试，包含 4,800 个提示词，涵盖 79 个物体类别、六个分类和八种极性设置，仅通过检测与几何评分进行评估。 先前的生成否定评估主要关注被否定的物体，而 NegT2IBench 还会否定属性与关系，同时要求对应的物体仍然存在，并在匹配提示复杂度的情况下比较肯定与否定提示。 (2) 一项针对 600 张图像的评估验证研究，通过与人类标注进行对比，分别对肯定与否定陈述将 NegT2IBench 与 14 种替代评分方法进行比较。 (3) 对十一种 T2I 配置、六个分类和八种极性设置中否定失败现象的精细分析，包括匹配负载的极性比较，以及揭示模型失败位置与方式的陈述级失败分类。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image models and compositional evaluation. Diffusion, flow-based, and autoregressive T2I models [ 51 , 48 , 20 , 8 , 60 , 11 , 10 , 56 , 15 , 14 ] and closed systems [ 7 , 6 , 46 ] follow increasingly complex prompts. However, advances mostly show results for whether requested content appears, not whether a specified attribute or relation is withheld. Distribution metrics such as FID [ 27 ] and alignment scores such as CLIPScore [ 26 ] give coarse quality and prompt following scores. Like our approach, GenEval [ 22 ] uses detectors to check objects, counts, colors, and positions, while PosEval [ 2 ] extends its position task; NegT2IBench builds on GenEval’s prompt schema and PosEval’s spatial encoding. Other benchmarks cover more attributes, relations, and longer prompts [ 32 , 31 , 29 , 5 , 23 , 33 ] . GenAI-Bench [ 37 ] and UniGenBench++ [ 59 ] include negation as a compositional skill or a grammar category, but neither separates attribute from relation negation or pairs negated prompts with positive ones. Detector-based benchmarks also face template contamination [ 63 ] , weakening detector-human agreement as models improve [ 33 ] , and sensitivity to wording [ 21 ] ; we therefore report human agreement by category and keep wording fixed across polarity conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像模型与组合评估。 扩散、流基和自回归 T2I 模型 [ 51 , 48 , 20 , 8 , 60 , 11 , 10 , 56 , 15 , 14 ] 以及封闭系统 [ 7 , 6 , 46 ] 能够遵循越来越复杂的提示。 然而，现有进展主要展示了所请求内容是否出现的结果，而非特定属性或关系是否被排除。 诸如 FID [ 27 ] 之类的分布指标和诸如 CLIPScore [ 26 ] 之类的对齐分数只能提供粗略的质量与提示遵循评分。 与我们的方法类似，GenEval [ 22 ] 使用检测器来检查对象、数量、颜色和位置，而 PosEval [ 2 ] 扩展了其位置任务；NegT2IBench 基于 GenEval 的提示方案与 PosEval 的空间编码构建而成。 其他基准测试涵盖了更多属性、关系和更长的提示 [ 32 , 31 , 29 , 5 , 23 , 33 ] 。 GenAI-Bench [ 37 ] 和 UniGenBench++ [ 59 ] 将否定视为一种组合技能或语法类别，但两者均未将属性否定与关系否定区分开，也未将否定提示与肯定提示配对。 基于检测器的基准测试还面临模板污染问题 [ 63 ]，随着模型性能提升，检测器与人类的一致性会减弱 [ 33 ]，且对措辞变化较为敏感 [ 21]；因此，我们按类别报告人类一致性，并在不同极性条件下保持措辞固定。

paragraphs.en: Negation in text-to-image generation. T2I models still render what a prompt forbids, across several languages [ 18 , 45 ] . NegGenBench [ 24 ] contains 200 prompt pairs and evaluates negative-prompt guidance: each prompt is paired with a separate negative prompt naming the content to exclude, instead of expressing the negation in the prompt itself. LMD [ 41 ] tests 100 scene-level prompts without a named object, scoring with an open-vocabulary detector and supplying the denied object via a negative-prompt input. NegationCLIP [ 47 ] evaluates 107 negated prompts with an MLLM judge, while NEG-TTOI [ 12 ] pairs a wanted object with an unwanted one in 2,000 prompts scored by GPT-4o. These studies establish that exclusion is hard, but none compares positive and negated versions of attributes and relations while requiring every named object to remain. A separate line of work steers generation away from unwanted content with negative prompts or guidance [ 28 , 44 , 55 , 13 , 19 ] . While steering generation with negative prompts can exclude unwanted content, it does not test whether the model follows a negation written in the prompt, which is what NegT2IBench measures.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像生成中的否定表达。 T2I 模型仍然会呈现提示词所禁止的内容，这种现象在多种语言中均存在 [ 18 , 45 ] 。 NegGenBench [ 24 ] 包含 200 对提示词，用于评估负向提示引导：每个提示词都与一个独立的负向提示词配对，后者明确说明需要排除的内容，而不是在提示词本身中直接表达否定。 LMD [ 41 ] 测试了 100 个不包含具体物体名称的场景级提示词，使用开放词汇检测器进行评分，并通过负向提示输入提供被禁止的物体。 NegationCLIP [ 47 ] 使用 MLLM 裁判评估了 107 个带有否定表达的提示词，而 NEG-TTOI [ 12 ] 则在 2,000 个提示词中，将所需物体与不需要的物体配对，并由 GPT-4o 进行评分。 这些研究证实了排除特定内容具有挑战性，但没有任何研究同时比较属性的正向和否定版本以及关系表达，并要求所有命名的物体都必须保留。 另一条独立的研究路线通过负向提示或引导，将生成过程引开不需要的内容 [ 28 , 44 , 55 , 13 , 19 ] 。 虽然使用负向提示引导生成可以排除不需要的内容，但这并未测试模型是否遵循提示词中书写的否定表达，而这就是 NegT2IBench 所测量的内容。

paragraphs.en: Judging negation. Image-text and preference scores such as CLIPScore [ 26 ] , BLIPScore [ 39 ] , ImageReward [ 64 ] , PickScore [ 35 ] , and HPSv2 [ 61 ] measure overall alignment, but performance on ordinary prompts does not indicate negation reliability: CLIP-family models perform near chance on negated captions [ 1 ] , VQA models perform much worse on negated questions [ 67 ] , and CC-Neg [ 54 ] provides negated captions for training. VQA-based methods such as TIFA [ 30 ] , which uses mPLUG [ 38 ] , and VQAScore [ 43 ] verify prompt requirements directly, but VQA judges, including Qwen3-VL [ 3 ] and InternVL3.5 [ 58 ] , can hallucinate absent details [ 16 , 62 ] , which matters when the evaluator must confirm that an attribute or relation is absent while the objects are present. Sammani et al. [52] propose a decomposed MLLM judge for negated image retrieval, but in our validation such judges lose up to 18.8 κ \kappa points when negations are phrased as negations (Section 4 ). We therefore score each element with dedicated perception components and report human agreement by category and polarity.
paragraphs.zh: 否定判断。 图像-文本和偏好分数（如 CLIPScore [ 26 ]、BLIPScore [ 39 ]、ImageReward [ 64 ]、PickScore [ 35 ] 和 HPSv2 [ 61 ]）衡量整体对齐程度，但普通提示下的表现并不能反映否定判断的可靠性：CLIP 系列模型在否定性描述上的表现接近随机水平 [ 1 ]，VQA 模型在否定性问题上的表现则差得多 [ 67]，而 CC-Neg [ 54 ] 则提供用于训练的否定性描述。 基于 VQA 的方法（如使用 mPLUG [ 38 ] 的 TIFA [ 30 ] 和 VQAScore [ 43 ]）会直接验证提示要求，但包括 Qwen3-VL [ 3 ] 和 InternVL3.5 [ 58 ] 在内的 VQA 判断模型可能会凭空捏造缺失的细节 [ 16 , 62 ]，而当评估器必须确认某个属性或关系不存在（尽管相关对象存在）时，这一点至关重要。Sammani 等人 [52] 提出了一种用于否定性图像检索的分解式 MLLM 判断模型，但在我们的验证中，当否定以明确否定的形式表达时，这类判断模型最多会损失 18.8 κ \kappa 分（第 4 节）。 因此，我们使用专门的感知组件对每个元素进行评分，并按类别和极性报告人类评估的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Task formulation. NegT2IBench measures how models respond when attributes and relations are negated. It tests both the effect of negation at a fixed number of statements and the effect of combining multiple statements in one prompt. Each prompt comes with metadata listing required objects and statements. A statement’s polarity specifies whether an attribute or relation must hold (positive) or must not hold (negated); all named objects remain required in either case. The eight settings vary the number of positive and negated statements; we write a setting as P:N, so 1:1 contains one of each, and call P+N its load. To capture diverse forms of negation in prompts, we cover two attribute and four relation categories (Table 1 ), illustrated by the examples in Figure 1 . Relation prompts link one shared subject to a different target for each statement, so M M statements name M + 1 M+1 objects and changing polarity leaves both counts fixed. To support reliable automatic evaluation, we use COCO [ 42 ] object classes recognized by the detector and attributes and relations that our pipeline can verify in both polarities.
paragraphs.zh: 任务构建。 NegT2IBench 衡量模型在属性和关系被否定时的响应方式。 它既测试在固定数量陈述中否定的影响，也测试将多个陈述组合到单个提示中的影响。 每个提示都附带元数据，列出了所需的对象和陈述。 一个陈述的极性指定了某个属性或关系必须成立（正向）还是必须不成立（否定）；无论哪种情况，所有命名的对象都必须存在。 八种设置通过调整正向和否定陈述的数量而变化；我们将一种设置表示为 P:N，例如 1:1 包含每种各一个，并称 P+N 为其负载。 为了捕捉提示中多样化的否定形式，我们涵盖了两种属性类别和四种关系类别（表 1），如图中示例所示。 关系提示将同一个共享主语与每个陈述中的不同目标连接起来，因此 M 个陈述会命名 M+1 个对象，而改变极性不会影响这两个数量。 为了支持可靠的自动评估，我们使用 COCO [42] 中检测器能够识别的对象类别，以及我们的处理流程能够在两种极性下验证的属性和关系。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark construction. We use GenEval’s color vocabulary and adapt the position rules [ 22 ] , select material values from OVAD [ 9 ] , and follow PosEval’s relation encoding [ 2 ] . An LLM [ 65 ] selects combinations of objects, attributes, and relations from fixed lists. It keeps combinations that are plausible or unusual but possible to depict, so each negated statement denies something that could reasonably appear. Rule-based templates turn these selections into prompts with consistent wording. We balance different types of objects, attributes, and relations by favoring the ones that are used least often. The benchmark contains 4,800 prompts, with 100 for each combination of six categories and eight settings. Each category includes all 79 eligible object classes. Appendix A.1 gives the settings, selection rules, and templates; Appendices C.1 and A.2 give the full vocabularies and distributions.
paragraphs.zh: 基准构建。 我们使用 GenEval 的颜色词汇表并调整其位置规则 [ 22 ]，从 OVAD [ 9 ] 中选择材料值，并遵循 PosEval 的关系编码方式 [ 2 ]。 一个 LLM [ 65 ] 会从固定列表中挑选物体、属性和关系的组合。 它会保留那些看似合理或虽不寻常但能够描绘的组合，因此每个否定陈述都会否定一个可能合理出现的内容。 基于规则的模板会将这些选择转化为措辞一致的提示。 我们通过优先选用使用频率最低的类型，来平衡不同类别的物体、属性和关系。 该基准包含 4,800 个提示，其中每类由六个类别和八个设置组合而成的提示有 100 个。 每个类别都包含全部 79 个符合条件的物体类别。 附录 A.1 提供了相关设置、选择规则和模板；附录 C.1 和 A.2 则列出了完整的词汇表和分布情况。

sents.en: It keeps combinations that are plausible or unusual but possible to depict, so each negated statement denies something that could reasonably appear.
sents.zh: 它会保留那些看似合理或虽不寻常但能够描绘的组合，因此每个否定陈述都会否定一个可能合理出现的内容。

sents.en: Rule-based templates turn these selections into prompts with consistent wording.
sents.zh: 基于规则的模板会将这些选择转化为措辞一致的提示。

sents.en: We balance different types of objects, attributes, and relations by favoring the ones that are used least often.
sents.zh: 我们通过优先选用使用频率最低的类型，来平衡不同类别的物体、属性和关系。

sents.en: The benchmark contains 4,800 prompts, with 100 for each combination of six categories and eight settings.
sents.zh: 该基准包含 4,800 个提示，其中每类由六个类别和八个设置组合而成的提示有 100 个。

sents.en: Each category includes all 79 eligible object classes.
sents.zh: 每个类别都包含全部 79 个符合条件的物体类别。

paragraphs.en: We check each prompt requirement separately to identify why an image fails. This could be a missing object, an incorrect count, or a violated attribute or relation. Each category uses the same verification rule (Appendix Table 14 ), making decisions reproducible and comparable across generators. Checking that every named object is present first prevents a model from satisfying a negated statement by omitting the object it refers to. Figure 2 illustrates this evaluation pipeline: both objects are present, but the horse is behind the computer mouse, violating the negated relation. We use RF-DETR-XL [ 50 ] to detect objects, SAM 2 [ 49 ] to refine their masks, and Depth-Anything V2 [ 66 ] to estimate depth for front-behind relations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分别检查每个提示词的要求，以识别图像失败的原因。 原因可能包括缺少物体、数量错误，或违反了某个属性或关系。 每个类别都使用相同的验证规则（附录表 14），这使得不同生成器之间的决策具有可重复性和可比性。 首先检查所有命名的物体是否都存在，可以防止模型通过省略所提及的物体来满足否定陈述。 图 2 展示了这一评估流程：两个物体都存在，但马位于计算机鼠标后面，违反了否定关系。 我们使用 RF-DETR-XL [ 50 ] 检测物体，SAM 2 [ 49 ] 优化其掩码，并使用 Depth-Anything V2 [ 66 ] 估计深度以判断前后关系。

paragraphs.en: Statement decisions. For color and material, SigLIP 2 [ 57 ] scores the masked object crop against the category’s values. For color, a positive attribute passes if its score is within 0.5 of the highest score; a negated attribute passes if its score is more than 0.5 below it. This prevents a near-tied negated value from being treated as absent. For material, the top-scoring value decides both polarities. For relations, positive statements pass when their rule holds, and negated statements pass when it does not. Directional, comparative, and depth rules can return no relation when measurements are ambiguous (a dead zone). Positive statements then fail, while the negated one passes because the denied relation was not found. Table 14 defines the rules and final thresholds. Appendix C.1 gives the full equations and implementation details, and Appendix E.2 reports the frequency of ambiguous passes. Appendix D compares detectors, mask refinement, and relation thresholds on a small subset of 140 140 images with a clear human-majority verdict, from 600 600 annotated images.
paragraphs.zh: 陈述性决策。 对于颜色和材质，SigLIP 2 [ 57 ] 将掩码对象裁剪区域与对应类别的值进行评分比较。 对于颜色，若正向属性的评分与最高评分的差值在 0.5 以内，则判定通过；若反向属性的评分比最高评分低超过 0.5，则判定通过。 这可以防止接近打平的反向值被误判为不存在。 对于材质，得分最高的值将决定两种极性。 对于关系，当规则成立时，正向陈述判定通过；当规则不成立时，反向陈述判定通过。 在测量结果存在歧义（即“死区”）时，方向性、比较性和深度规则可能返回“无关系”。 此时，正向陈述将判定失败，而反向陈述则会通过，因为所否定的关系并未被发现。 表 14 定义了相关规则和最终阈值。 附录 C.1 提供了完整的公式和实现细节，附录 E.2 报告了歧义通过的频率。 附录 D 在由 600×600 张标注图像中选取的、包含 140×140 张图像的小型子集上，对检测器、掩码优化和关系阈值进行了比较，这些图像均有明确的人类多数判定结果。

paragraphs.en: Metrics. Image accuracy is the fraction of generated images that satisfy the full prompt: all required objects appear with valid counts, and every positive and negated statement passes. Prompt accuracy is the fraction of prompts for which at least one of four generated images is correct. The first measures success per image; the second measures success within four attempts. We report image accuracy by category and setting, with overall scores averaged equally across the six categories; prompt accuracy is released with the per-prompt results. Each failed statement is also assigned one of five failure causes, which Section 5 uses to diagnose where models fail; failure and metric definitions appear in Appendix C.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 指标。 图像准确率是指生成的图像中满足完整提示词的比例：所有必要对象均以有效数量出现，且每个肯定和否定的陈述均通过验证。 提示词准确率是指至少有一张生成的图像正确的提示词所占比例（在四张生成图像中）。 前者衡量每张图像的成功率；后者衡量四次尝试内的成功率。 我们按类别和设置报告图像准确率，其中总体分数对六个类别进行等权平均；提示词准确率则随每个提示词的具体结果一同公布。 每个失败的陈述还会被分配一个来自五种失败原因之一的标签，第 5 节将利用这些原因来诊断模型失败的位置；失败与指标的定义见附录 C.3。

paragraphs.en: Since NegT2IBench scores images automatically, its verdicts matter only if they match human judgment. We test this with a human study and compare NegT2IBench with other evaluators.

paragraphs.en: Human reference. A pool of 36 annotators labeled 600 generated images, with three labels per image, answering one yes/no question per object and per statement. We broke down each prompt into its objects and statements and phrased each statement as a question about whether it holds: for “a non-wooden bench”, annotators say whether the bench is wooden, and the correct answer is “no”. The majority vote on each element gives two references: a binary image label, true only if every element is correct, and a continuous score, the fraction of correct elements. Some images are ambiguous, so we also report an inter-annotator score (H. Inter-annotator), computed by scoring each annotator against the majority of the other two (Appendix B.1 ). Evaluators are scored against the majority of all three annotators, a less noisy reference, so they can exceed this value.
paragraphs.zh: 人类参考标准。 一组由 36 名标注员组成的团队对 600 张生成的图像进行了标注，每张图像有三个标签，每个物体和每个陈述都需要回答一个“是/否”问题。 我们将每个提示分解为其中的物体和陈述，并将每个陈述转化为一个关于其是否成立的问题：例如对于“一个非木制的长凳”，标注员需要判断该长凳是否为木制，正确答案是“否”。 对每个元素进行多数投票后，会得出两个参考结果：一个二值图像标签（仅当所有元素都正确时结果为“真”），以及一个连续分数（即正确元素的比例）。 有些图像存在歧义，因此我们还报告了标注员间的一致性得分（H. 标注员间一致性），其计算方式是将每位标注员的评分与另外两位标注员的多数意见进行比较（附录 B.1）。 评估者的评分会与所有三位标注员的多数意见进行比较，这一参考标准噪声更小，因此评估者的得分可能高于该值。

paragraphs.en: Evaluators. We compare NegT2IBench (Section 3.1 ) with eight VQA judges: mPLUG [ 38 ] , VQAScore [ 43 ] , Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 4 ] , InternVL3-8B [ 68 ] , Qwen3-VL-8B and 32B [ 3 ] , and InternVL3.5-8B and 38B [ 58 ] . Each judge answers yes/no questions in three modes: one question for the whole prompt (whole), the annotators’ per-element questions (pos.), and the same questions with negated statements asked in negated form (neg.). The probability of the correct answer produces a continuous score, while an answer with a probability greater than 0.5 0.5 yields a binary verdict. In per-element mode, an image passes only if every element receives the correct answer, similar to human labeling. NegT2IBench runs one detector pass per image, so it has a single mode. We also test six image-text similarity and reward scores, which have no binary form (see Appendix B.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 评估者。我们将 NegT2IBench（第 3.1 节）与八种 VQA 判据进行比较：mPLUG [38]、VQAScore [43]、Qwen2.5-VL-7B [4]、InternVL3-8B [68]、Qwen3-VL-8B 和 32B [3]，以及 InternVL3.5-8B 和 38B [58]。每种判据都以三种模式回答“是/否”问题：针对整个提示的一个问题（whole）、针对标注者每个元素的问题（pos.），以及以否定形式提出的相同问题（neg.）。正确答案的概率会生成一个连续分数，而概率大于 0.5 的答案则会得出一个二元判定。在逐元素模式下，只有当每个元素都得到正确答案时，图像才算通过，这与人类的标注方式类似。NegT2IBench 对每张图像仅运行一次检测器，因此它只有一种模式。我们还测试了六种图像-文本相似性和奖励分数，这些分数没有二元形式（参见附录 B.3）。

paragraphs.en: Agreement with humans. Table 2 reports Cohen’s κ \kappa [ 17 ] , precision and recall against the binary label (per-element mode for judges), and Kendall τ \tau [ 34 ] against the continuous score. NegT2IBench reaches κ = 72.0 \kappa=72.0 , above the human inter-annotator score ( 65.6 65.6 ), and τ = 65.1 \tau=65.1 , above the best judge, Qwen3-VL-32B ( 63.3 63.3 ; bootstrap intervals overlap, Table 7 ). On κ \kappa , only Qwen3-VL-32B scores higher ( 74.3 74.3 ), while the other seven judges score below NegT2IBench on both measures. Size adds little: scaling Qwen3-VL from 8 8 B to 32 32 B gains 4.6 4.6 points of κ \kappa , and InternVL3.5 from 8 8 B to 38 38 B gains 0.5 0.5 . Similarity and reward scores reach at most τ = 27.7 \tau=27.7 and cannot tell whether a negated requirement holds (Table 7 ). In Table 2 , NegT2IBench has the highest recall of any evaluator ( 85.0 85.0 vs. 82.0 82.0 for the best judge) and trails it on precision ( 79.2 79.2 vs. 84.1 84.1 ), so it rejects fewer human-accepted images than any judge: the failures we report are not an artifact of a strict evaluator (Appendix B.5 ).

paragraphs.en: Negative phrasing effect. When we ask negated statements in negated form (“is the bench non-wooden?”) and keep all other questions the same ( Δ \Delta in Table 2 ), all judges lose 1.3 to 18.8 points of κ \kappa , and five of them lose 4.5 to 6.9 points of τ \tau , including the largest models. Judge verdicts thus depend on wording, the very variable a negation benchmark changes. NegT2IBench checks each requirement directly instead of answering a question, so wording does not affect it, and it beats every judge under whole prompt and negated phrasing (Appendix B.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 否定措辞效应。 当我们以否定形式提出否定陈述（“长凳是非木制的吗？”），而其他所有问题保持不变（表 2 中的 Δ \Delta）时，所有评分者的 κ \kappa 值都会下降 1.3 到 18.8 分，其中五名评分者的 τ \tau 值会下降 4.5 到 6.9 分，包括最大的模型。 因此，评分者的裁决取决于措辞，而这正是否定基准所改变的变量。 NegT2IBench 直接检查每个要求，而不是回答问题，因此措辞不会影响它，并且在完整提示和否定措辞下，它的表现优于所有评分者（附录 B.6）。

paragraphs.en: Cost. The NegT2IBench detector-based evaluator uses 1.24 1.24 B parameters and scores an image in 0.78 0.78 s with 6.3 6.3 GiB of GPU memory, measured on one GPU with one process and no batching. Judges with similar agreement use 8 8 B to 38 38 B parameters, 2.7 2.7 to 11.6 11.6 times more memory ( 16.8 16.8 to 73.0 73.0 GiB), and 0.49 0.49 - 3.29 3.29 s per image, measured per question and multiplied by the mean of 4.66 4.66 questions per image. Their cost also grows with the number of elements, since they ask one question per element, while NegT2IBench runs its detector once per image (Appendix B.4 ). paragraphs.en: Table 3 reports accuracy by polarity, statement load, and semantic category. The strongest model, BLIP3-o NEXT, reaches 31.4 % 31.4\% . Scores vary by about ± 0.7 \pm 0.7 points overall and ± 2 \pm 2 points per subtask by chance alone (95% interval). The top three models lie within 1.1 points, so overall score cannot separate them, but subtasks can. Janus-Pro-7B ties FLUX.2-klein-9B fourth at 26.6 % 26.6\% overall, yet first on negated single statement at 54.8 % 54.8\% , ahead of BLIP3-o NEXT at 48.7 % 48.7\% , and first on color at 39.8 % 39.8\% . FLUX.2-dev (4-bit) is the opposite: first on the asserted single statement at 76.3 % 76.3\% , and 42.6 % 42.6\% once negated. Accuracy on one negated statement spans 29.0 29.0 to 54.8 % 54.8\% , a wider range than overall score. Four models lead at least one subtask, and none leads more than three of eight polarity subtasks or two of six category subtasks.

paragraphs.en: Polarity and compositional load. At Load 1, nine of eleven configurations score higher on the asserted statement (1:0) than on the negated one (0:1); the exceptions are the two SD 1.5 variants. At Load 2, the same nine score highest on the all-positive setting (2:0). Across those nine, drop averages 22.7 22.7 points, from 0.4 0.4 to 43.8 43.8 . Load matters on its own. Between 1:1 and 0:2 there is no consistent ordering, so after the first negation the number of statements matters as much as how many are negated. Accuracy then collapses as load grows: the best score in each group falls from 76.3 % 76.3\% at Load 1 to 17.9 % 17.9\% at Load 3 and 8.4 % 8.4\% at Load 4. NegT2IBench exposes two separate difficulties: negation is harder than assertion at equal load, and satisfying several constraints at once is hard whatever their polarity.

paragraphs.en: Penalty depends on category. At Load 1, the drop is largest for the attributes: 53.7 53.7 points for color, from 85.0 % 85.0\% asserted to 31.3 % 31.3\% denied, and 17.0 17.0 points for material. Relations lose less, 16.6 16.6 points for comparative, 14.6 14.6 for directional. Proximity barely moves, 45.8 % 45.8\% vs. 43.2 % 43.2\% . Depth is opposite, 41.7 % 41.7\% vs. 44.0 % 44.0\% . This reversal is largely explained by dead-zone passes rather than by better negation Categories with higher positive accuracy also lose more when negated (Spearman ρ = 0.94 \rho=0.94 across the six categories). A larger drop therefore does not by itself show that a category is harder to negate; it may partly reflect a higher starting point (see Appendix E.2 for more details).

paragraphs.en: Two caveats apply when reading these comparisons. First, the size of a model’s drop does not rank its negation ability, because the drop is capped by the model’s accuracy on the positive statement: FLUX.2-klein-9B scores 72.8 % 72.8\% at 1:0 and loses 43.8 43.8 points at 0:1, while Janus-Pro-7B scores 55.2 % 55.2\% , loses 0.4 0.4 , and still reaches the highest negated accuracy. A model that is weak on the assertion has less to lose on the denial, so only the within-model comparison is safe to read. Second, NegT2IBench measures whether a negated attribute or relation is absent from the image, not whether the model understood the negation. A negated statement is easier to satisfy by chance than a positive one, so a model that ignores the negation can still pass some negated statements. A control prompt that omits the tested attribute or relation would separate the two; it fits the current design and is left for future work (Appendix F ).

paragraphs.en: Failure analysis. Every failed statement falls into one of five causes: undetected object, over-count, positive violation, negated violation, or dead-zone failure, defined in Appendix C.3 . Of the 280,067 failed statements, negated violations are the largest group at 41.5 % 41.5\% . Positive violations follow at 25.9 % 25.9\% , then over-counts at 15.0 % 15.0\% , undetected objects at 12.6 % 12.6\% , and dead-zone failures at 5.0 % 5.0\% . The most common failure is a model rendering what the prompt forbade. Dead zones, the only cause attributable to the evaluator alone, are the smallest at 5.0 % 5.0\% . Within the same prompt, negated statements fail more often than positive ones (Figure 3 (a)). At 1:1, the negated statement causes 43% of failures and the positive one 26%; at 1:2, the two negated statements cause 56% and the positive one 14%, twice as much per statement. Per statement, the imbalance holds in all four mixed settings, by a factor of 1.3 1.3 to 2.0 2.0 . The share of negated violations also varies by category (Figure 3 (b)): they account for 61% of failures for color and 43% for material, but 34 to 41% for the four relations. Negated colors are thus most often rendered, resulting in an incorrect image. Polarity therefore changes which constraint a model breaks, not only how often it breaks one. Appendix E.2 gives the per-model and row-level breakdowns.
paragraphs.zh: 故障分析。 每条失败的陈述都归因于五种原因之一：未检测到的对象、过度计数、正向违规、否定违规或死区故障，具体定义见附录 C.3。 在 280,067 条失败陈述中，否定违规占比最大，为 41.5%（41.5\%）。 其次是正向违规，占 25.9%（25.9\%），然后是过度计数，占 15.0%（15.0\%），未检测到的对象占 12.6%（12.6\%），死区故障占 5.0%（5.0\%）。 最常见的故障是模型生成了提示所禁止的内容。 死区故障是唯一完全由评估器自身导致的原因，其比例最低，为 5.0%（5.0\%）。 在同一提示中，否定陈述的失败率高于正向陈述（图 3(a)）。 在 1:1 设置下，否定陈述导致了 43% 的故障，而正向陈述为 26%；在 1:2 设置下，两条否定陈述分别导致了 56% 的故障，而正向陈述为 14%，即每条否定陈述的故障率是正向陈述的两倍。 就单条陈述而言，在所有四种混合设置中，这种不平衡现象均存在，比例在 1.3（1.3）到 2.0（2.0）之间。 否定违规的比例也因类别而异（图 3(b)）：它们在颜色相关故障中占 61%，在材料相关故障中占 43%，但在四种关系相关故障中仅占 34% 至 41%。 因此，被否定的颜色最常被生成，从而产生错误的图像。 由此可见，陈述的极性不仅影响模型违反约束的频率，还决定了其违反的是哪项约束。 附录 E.2 提供了各模型和各行级别的详细分析。

paragraphs.en: Dead zones. Directional, comparative, and depth relations have deliberate dead zones. When the measured geometry is ambiguous, the evaluator returns no predicate rather than forcing one. This is often the correct outcome: two objects at similar depth are neither in front of nor behind each other. Proximity has no dead zone, because near and far are exact complements. Dead zones affect the two polarities differently. An asserted statement fails when its predicate is absent. A negated statement passes when the forbidden predicate is absent, including when no predicate is resolved at all. Such a pass is valid under the benchmark rule, but rests on weaker evidence than one where an alternative relation is established. Of the negated relation statements that pass, 19.0% pass only because no relation was resolved. This happens mostly for depth (55.5%, vs. 9.2% for directional and 2.9% for comparative), which explains why depth is the only category where negated statements score higher than positive ones at Load 1. Table 19 in Appendix E.2 reports exposure per category.
paragraphs.zh: 死区。 方向性、比较性和深度关系都刻意设置了死区。 当测得的几何结构存在歧义时，评估器会返回无谓词，而不是强行指定一个。 这通常是正确的结果：处于相似深度的两个物体既不在彼此前方，也不在彼此后方。 邻近性没有死区，因为“近”和“远”是精确互补的。 死区对两种极性产生的影响不同。 当断言的陈述缺少其谓词时，该陈述会失败。 当被禁止的谓词不存在时，否定陈述会通过测试，包括在完全没有谓词被确定的情况下。 根据基准规则，这种通过是有效的，但其依据的证据比确立替代关系的案例更薄弱。 在所有通过的否定关系陈述中，有 19.0% 仅因未确定任何关系而通过。 这种情况主要发生在深度上（55.5%，而方向性为 9.2%，比较性为 2.9%），这也解释了为何在负载 1 的情况下，深度是唯一一个否定陈述得分高于肯定陈述的类别。 附录 E.2 中的表 19 报告了各类别的暴露情况。

paragraphs.en: Negation-aware text encoders. NegationCLIP [ 47 ] replaces SD 1.5’s text encoder and raises overall accuracy from 14.5 % 14.5\% to 14.9 % 14.9\% . Both SD 1.5 variants score higher at 0:1 than at 1:0, and both stay far below the other models. The comparison is not clean: the two runs share a checkpoint and a 50-step schedule, but use guidance scales of 9.0 and 7.5. It is suggestive rather than a causal encoder test (Appendix E.2 ). Representing “not red” differently from “red” helps only if the generator can act on the distinction. The same applies to a classifier-free-guidance negative prompt, which steers sampling away from unwanted content without the model interpreting the negation [ 28 , 47 , 12 ] . Improving negation is therefore likely to require training or conditioning on negation-bearing supervision, not an encoder swap or a negative-prompt field. NegT2IBench measures whether such methods work, both on attributes and relations.

paragraphs.en: We introduced NegT2IBench , a benchmark that measures whether T2I models can withhold what a prompt forbids while still rendering every object it names. It compares positive and negated prompts at matched complexity and object counts, guards against success by omission, and reduces accidental success. Its detector-based evaluator agrees with human labels comparably to much larger vision-language judges while using a fraction of their GPU memory, and, unlike these judges, does not depend on how the evaluation question is phrased. Across eleven T2I configurations and 211,200 generated images, nine of eleven score lower on a single negated statement than on a single positive one, with a loss that depends on the category and compounds as statements are combined. Polarity also changes which model leads and which error it makes. Generating what a prompt asks for and withholding what it forbids are thus distinct abilities, and an aggregate compositional score hides the second. NegT2IBench measures it directly, providing a controlled testbed for future models and for methods that aim to improve negation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 NegT2IBench，一个用于衡量 T2I 模型能否在拒绝生成提示词所禁止内容的同时，仍准确呈现提示词中提到的所有对象的基准测试。 该测试通过匹配复杂度和对象数量的正向与否定提示词进行比较，防止因遗漏而误判成功，并减少偶然成功的概率。 其基于检测器的评估器在与人类标签的一致性方面，与规模大得多的视觉-语言模型评估器相当，同时仅使用后者一小部分的 GPU 内存；而且与这些评估器不同，它不依赖于评估问题的具体措辞。 在十一组 T2I 配置和 211,200 张生成图像中，有九组的得分在单个否定陈述上低于单个正向陈述，且这种分差取决于陈述组合时的类别和复合结构。 极性变化还会影响哪个模型表现领先，以及它会产生哪种错误。 因此，生成提示词所要求的内容与拒绝生成其禁止的内容是两种不同的能力，而综合的组成性得分会掩盖后一种能力。 NegT2IBench 能够直接衡量这一能力，为未来模型和旨在改进否定处理的方法提供了一个受控的测试平台。

paragraphs.en: In this study, 36 annotators labeled 600 images, three per image, using the interface in Figure 7 . The reference for an element is the majority of the three answers. Inter-annotator) with a leave-one-out scheme: each annotator’s labels are scored against the majority of the other two, and the score is averaged over the three held-out annotators. Table 5 reports agreement between annotators: Fleiss’ κ \kappa is 72.4 72.4 over all statements, and 84.9 % 84.9\% of statements are answered unanimously. paragraphs.en: We measure every method on the same 600 images on one H200 NVL GPU, with one process, no batching, and eight CPU threads. Pinning the threads changes wall-clock time by a factor of 1.2 1.2 and CPU time by a factor of 8 8 , but changes no verdict. Reported time excludes model loading, which Table 8 lists separately. GPU memory is torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated for every method, so all values share one basis; the allocator’s reserved memory is larger and not comparable across frameworks. paragraphs.en: Cohen’s κ \kappa merges two kinds of error into one number. Table 9 separates them for the per-element mode, the mode behind the precision and recall of Table 2 . TP: the annotators and the evaluator both accept the image; TN: both reject it; FP: the annotators reject it but the evaluator passes it; FN: the annotators accept it but the evaluator rejects it. Prec. = TP / ( TP + FP ) =\mathrm{TP}/(\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP}) and Rec. = TP / ( TP + FN ) =\mathrm{TP}/(\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FN}) . Called correct (%) corresponds to the share of the 600 images the evaluator passes, ( TP + FP ) / 600 (\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP})/600 . Humans accept 34.3 % 34.3\% of the images.
paragraphs.zh: Cohen’s κ \kappa 将两种类型的错误合并为一个数值。 表 9 针对每个元素的模式对这两种错误进行了区分，这种模式正是表 2 中精确率和召回率的基础。 TP：标注员和评估者都接受该图像；TN：两者都拒绝该图像；FP：标注员拒绝该图像，但评估者通过该图像；FN：标注员接受该图像，但评估者拒绝该图像。 精确率 = TP / ( TP + FP ) =\mathrm{TP}/(\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP})，召回率 = TP / ( TP + FN ) =\mathrm{TP}/(\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FN})。 “正确率 (%)”对应于评估者通过的 600 张图像中所占的比例，即 ( TP + FP ) / 600 (\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP})/600。 人类接受了 34.3 % 34.3\% 的图像。

paragraphs.en: Directional, comparative, and depth contain a deliberate dead zone in which no predicate fires because the measured geometry is not sufficiently decisive. A positive statement fails in such a region, whereas a negated statement passes because the denied predicate is absent. Proximity has no dead zone by construction because its two predicates are exact complements. Attribute confusion sets are also never empty because they always include the top-scoring value.
paragraphs.zh: 方向性、比较性和深度判断中故意设置了一个死区，在该区域内没有任何谓词被触发，因为测得的几何信息不够明确。 在这样的区域中，肯定性陈述会失败，而否定性陈述则会通过，因为被否定的谓词并不存在。 根据构造，邻近性判断不存在死区，因为其两个谓词是精确互补的。 属性混淆集也绝不会为空，因为它们总是包含得分最高的值。

paragraphs.en: Dead-zone analysis. Directional, comparative, and depth relations contain a deliberate dead zone : when the measured geometry is insufficient to support any predicate in the category, the evaluator returns an empty predicate set rather than forcing a decision. This can be the correct outcome; for example, two objects at approximately the same depth may be neither clearly in front of nor behind one another.
paragraphs.zh: 死区分析。 方向性、比较性和深度关系包含一个有意设计的死区：当测量到的几何信息不足以支持该类别中的任何谓词时，评估器会返回一个空的谓词集合，而不是强行做出判断。 这可能是正确的结果；例如，两个深度大致相同的物体可能既不能明确判断为在前，也不能明确判断为在后。

paragraphs.en: NegT2IBench is limited to what can be verified automatically in both polarities: color, material, and four spatial and size relations over 79 COCO classes. Contact, interactions such as holding or riding, and the negated presence of whole objects are not covered, and are natural extensions as detectors improve. Comparative relations also measure apparent image size rather than real-world size. Negation is expressed in one English form (“non- value ”, “is not relation ”), and relation prompts link one subject to every target. This keeps polarity comparisons controlled, but robustness to paraphrases, other languages, and richer relation structures is not tested; these can be added on the same evaluation pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: NegT2IBench 仅限于在两种极性下都能自动验证的内容：颜色、材料，以及 79 个 COCO 类别中的四种空间关系和尺寸关系。 接触、互动（如握手或乘坐）以及整个物体的否定存在情况并未涵盖在内，但随着检测器的改进，这些内容将成为自然的扩展。 比较关系测量的也是图像中的表观尺寸，而非现实世界中的实际尺寸。 否定通过一种英文形式表达（“非-值”、“不是关系”），而关系提示则将每个主语与所有目标关联起来。 这样虽然能控制极性比较的规模，但并未测试其对改写、其他语言及更丰富的关系结构的鲁棒性；这些内容可以在同一评估流程中添加。

sents.en: NegT2IBench is limited to what can be verified automatically in both polarities: color, material, and four spatial and size relations over 79 COCO classes.
sents.zh: NegT2IBench 仅限于在两种极性下都能自动验证的内容：颜色、材料，以及 79 个 COCO 类别中的四种空间关系和尺寸关系。

sents.en: Contact, interactions such as holding or riding, and the negated presence of whole objects are not covered, and are natural extensions as detectors improve.
sents.zh: 接触、互动（如握手或乘坐）以及整个物体的否定存在情况并未涵盖在内，但随着检测器的改进，这些内容将成为自然的扩展。

sents.en: Comparative relations also measure apparent image size rather than real-world size.
sents.zh: 比较关系测量的也是图像中的表观尺寸，而非现实世界中的实际尺寸。

sents.en: Negation is expressed in one English form (“non- value ”, “is not relation ”), and relation prompts link one subject to every target.
sents.zh: 否定通过一种英文形式表达（“非-值”、“不是关系”），而关系提示则将每个主语与所有目标关联起来。

sents.en: This keeps polarity comparisons controlled, but robustness to paraphrases, other languages, and richer relation structures is not tested; these can be added on the same evaluation pipeline.
sents.zh: 这样虽然能控制极性比较的规模，但并未测试其对改写、其他语言及更丰富的关系结构的鲁棒性；这些内容可以在同一评估流程中添加。

paragraphs.en: NegT2IBench measures whether negated content is absent from the image, not whether the model understood the negation. Because negated statements are easier to satisfy by chance than positive ones, a model that ignores a negation can still pass some negated statements. A control prompt that omits the tested attribute or relation would separate the two, and fits the current design. Scores depend on off-the-shelf perception models (RF-DETR, SAM 2, SigLIP 2, and Depth-Anything V2), so benchmark accuracy is bounded by their quality; the modular design lets each component be replaced as stronger models appear. Finally, we evaluate open-weight models under their native inference settings rather than a matched compute budget; closed systems can be scored with the same protocol.
paragraphs.zh: NegT2IBench 衡量的是否定内容是否未出现在图像中，而非模型是否理解了否定含义。 由于否定陈述比肯定陈述更容易被偶然满足，因此忽略否定的模型仍然可能通过某些否定陈述的测试。 一个省略所测试属性或关系的控制提示可以区分这两种情况，并且符合当前的设计。 得分取决于现成的感知模型（RF-DETR、SAM 2、SigLIP 2 和 Depth-Anything V2），因此基准测试的准确性受这些模型质量限制；模块化设计允许在出现更强大的模型时替换每个组件。 最后，我们在开放权重模型的原始推理设置下对其进行评估，而不是在匹配的计算预算下；封闭系统也可以使用相同的协议进行评分。

sents.zh: NegT2IBench 衡量的是否定内容是否未出现在图像中，而非模型是否理解了否定含义。
